title: SAES extraction row
description: One directional relationship between two variables, extracted from one paper. Implements ontology specification v0.1.2. Every coded field is paired with the verbatim text it was derived from.

paper_id.description: A1. Unique identifier for the source paper (DOI or OpenAlex ID). Must match the include set from screening_decisions.csv.

paper_section.description: A2. Section of the paper where the relationship was found.

version.description: A3. Version of the extraction protocol used.

subject_raw.description: B1. Exact phrase from the paper describing the subject. Verbatim, in double quotes.

subject_code.description: B2. Standardised term from the controlled vocabulary. If no vocabulary is provided, the most precise consistent term derivable from the text. Suspect codes flagged with [UNVERIFIED].

subject_trend_only.description: B3. Yes if the subject's trajectory is described but no relationship to an object is asserted. When Yes, object_raw and object_code are left empty.

object_raw.description: C1. Exact phrase from the paper describing the object. Empty if subject_trend_only=Yes.

object_code.description: C2. Standardised term from the controlled vocabulary. Empty if subject_trend_only=Yes.

rel_raw.description: D1. Exact phrase describing the relationship between subject and object.

rel_exists.description: D2. Does the paper claim a relationship exists?

rel_direction.description: D3. Direction of the claimed relationship.

rel_valence.description: D4. Sign of the effect (does the subject increase or decrease the object?).

rel_conditionality_raw.description: D5. Any stated conditions under which the relationship holds.

rel_uncertainty_raw.description: D7. Hedging language used by the authors.

rel_uncertainty_code.description: D8. Coded certainty level expressed by the authors.

rel_exists_note.description: D9. Flags unusual negation or existence edge cases. Prefix audit flags with [FLAG].

effect_raw.description: E1. Exact phrase reporting effect size or magnitude.

effect_metric.description: E2. Statistical metric used, if any (e.g. odds ratio, beta coefficient, % change, narrative only).

effect_magnitude.description: E3. Numeric value if reported; otherwise a qualitative descriptor or "not reported".

effect_error_metric.description: E4. Error metric used, if any (e.g. standard error, confidence interval).

effect_error_magnitude.description: E5. Numeric value if reported; otherwise a qualitative descriptor or "not reported".

source_locus.description: F1. Is this relationship original to this paper or cited from elsewhere?

source_citation_raw.description: F2. Citation used if the claim is attributed elsewhere (required if source_locus != "Original to this study").

method_raw.description: G1. Methodological language used by the authors.

causal_inference_level.description: G3. Maximum level of causal inference the method supports.

geographic_scope_raw.description: H1. Location or geographic context as stated in the paper.

temporal_scope_raw.description: H3. Time period or temporal context as stated in the paper.

temporal_scope_code.description: H4. Standardised temporal classification (e.g. snapshot, multi-year, decadal, multi-decadal).

population_raw.description: H5. Population or system unit of study as stated in the paper.

population_code.description: H6. Coded population or system type.
